title: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA)
sourceType: Official Space Agency Archive & Master Catalog
supportedRecords: All Apollo, Surveyor, Lunar Orbiter, Viking, Pathfinder, and planetary mission records
auditNotes: Master repository for COSPAR IDs, launch dates, landing coordinates, and mission outcomes.

title: JPL Mars Exploration Program Archive & Mission Portals
supportedRecords: Curiosity, Perseverance, Ingenuity, Opportunity, Spirit, InSight, Odyssey, MRO
auditNotes: Live telemetry updates, distance logs (Perseverance 45.22 km, Oct 2026), and engineering logs.

title: Apollo Lunar Surface Journal (ALSJ)
supportedRecords: Apollo 11 Eagle Descent Stage, Apollo 15 LRV, Surveyor 3 Apollo 12 visit
auditNotes: Verified air-to-ground radio logs, plaque transcriptions, coordinates, and photo indices.

title: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) Science Archive
supportedRecords: Apollo 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17 landing sites, Surveyor, Lunar Orbiter impacts
auditNotes: Sub-meter high-resolution orbital confirmation of lunar hardware positions and rover wheel tracks.

title: USGS Astrogeology Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature
supportedRecords: All planetary landing site names, craters, valleys, and coordinate standards
auditNotes: Provides standard east-positive longitude definitions and named features.
